translations.web: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.
translations.bsb: While you are sowing in the eighth year, you will be eating from the previous harvest, until the ninth year’s harvest comes in.
